We have all needed results: test set evaluation metrics from train_xgboost_model (test_metrics) and feature_importance. Also cross-validation results r2_mean and r2_std from perform_cross_validation.

Need to save results as JSON file with keys test_set_evaluation and cross_validation_results, containing required subkeys.

We have test_metrics: mae, rmse, r2. Also feature_importance dict.

Cross-validation results: r2_mean, r2_std.

We need to create a JSON file in workspace, maybe at path "model_evaluation_results.json". Use write_file tool.

Construct JSON content.
